chat.author: Jeffrey Haas
chat.text: The fundamental issue with UPA in any form that isn't a separate AFI/SAFI is it is subject to "attribute escape" problems.  Several aspects of the proposal are straight from my draft: What happens when an edge doesn't enforce the procedure? What about if cleanup doesn't happen at egress or ingress?  The result is a unicast IP4/IPv6 route might leak out somewhere.  This may happen also if this is an l3vpn, evpn type 5 or evpn-ipvpn procedure is used.

chat.author: Jeffrey Haas
chat.text: and if the UPA entry is not generated from the source of the aggregate and instead comes from a proxy generator, different loss can happen.  (router-id may help with troubleshooting in some circumstances)

chat.author: Jeffrey Haas
chat.text: The underlying idea of "locally generate the blackhole" is understood.
